scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w seller && npm run build -w admin
scripts.test:shared: node --test shared/src/seller/seller.test.js shared/src/seller/exceptions.test.js scripts/activate-seller.test.mjs scripts/admin-roles.test.mjs seller/src/api/api.test.js
scripts.test:db: node --test --test-concurrency=1 supabase/tests/seller.test.mjs supabase/tests/subscription.test.mjs supabase/tests/exceptions.test.mjs supabase/tests/admin.test.mjs supabase/tests/seed.test.mjs supabase/tests/admin-schema.test.mjs
scripts.test:fn: deno test --no-check -A --node-modules-dir=none supabase/tests/functions.test.ts supabase/tests/proofs.test.ts supabase/tests/shared-pure.test.ts supabase/tests/shared-admin.test.ts supabase/tests/admin.test.ts supabase/tests/admin-shared.test.ts
scripts.test:seller-backend: npm run sync:shared -- --check && npm run test:shared && npm run test:db && npm run test:fn && npm run test:fn:db
scripts.test:all: npm run test:seller-backend && npm run test:seller-ui && npm run test:client
scripts.test:admin-backend: npm run test:fn && npm run test:db
